description: Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco. The listing groups 36 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Predicción Marítima de 2010; Predicción Marítima de 2013; Predicción Marítima del 2021; Predicción Marítima del 2024. Formats seen: XML, CSV, API, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
